articles.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
articles.snippet: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

articles.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
articles.snippet: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.

articles.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
articles.snippet: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

articles.title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
articles.snippet: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.

articles.title: Protesters Arrested Outside Nasdaq as Activists Oppose Anthropic IPO Over AI Bubble Risks
articles.snippet: At least four people were arrested outside Nasdaq during Anthropic’s historic IPO, as protesters warned that AI valuations could leave retirement savers exposed to a potential market crash and broader economic losses.
